- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Make the criterion hint match the validation mode — With `require_shall=True`, the validator rejects `- Save the result`, even though it follows the new hint to write a direct action bullet “without the word shall.” `test_plain_bullet_under_shall_option` asserts that rejection. — Authors using `require_shall=True` receive guidance that leads them to submit a criterion the validator rejects. — Fix: Make the hint conditional on `require_shall`, or limit it to guidance that applies in both modes.
